name: Bistro CoCoriCo
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Bistro CoCoriCo in Innsbruck** – a cozy spot where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern flair. Savor authentic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a perfectly brewed **Melange**, all crafted with local ingredients. Whether you're here for breakfast, lunch, or a relaxed dinner, our warm atmosphere and delicious flavors make every visit unforgettable. **Genießen Sie Ihr Essen bei uns!**
